agendaItems.background: The project will complete the West Riverwalk within the West Tampa Community Redevelopment Area and will include, but not be limited to, the construction of a shared-use bicycle and pedestrian path along the western bank of the Hillsborough River from the center of West Cass Street to a point near Willow Avenue. At this northern riverfront end, the pathway will include an east-west connection to North Rome Avenue and will include pedestrian improvements through this corridor. The project will exclude a portion of the West Riverwalk path portion between the eastern right-of-way lines of both North Willow Avenue and North Oregon Avenue which portion is to be constructed by the Rome Yard Developer, Related Group, per their Master Development Agreement.

ContactMia Dorton 8132748643
SubjectCRA Staff requests Board approval for the West Riverwalk Multi-Modal 
Network and Safety Improvement Grant Funding agreement between the

Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, approving the West Riverwalk Multi-Modal Network and Safety 
Improvements Grant Funding Agreement to construct a new multimodal 
network along West Tampa in connection with contract 22-C-00001; Tampa 
Multimodal Network and Safety Improvements Project by and between said 
Community Redevelopment Agency (“CRA”) and the City of Tampa, Florida 
(“Grant Recipient”) on property located within the boundaries of the West 
Tampa Community Redevelopment Area; authorizing execution of the 
Community Redevelopment Grant Funding Agreement by the Chair of the 
CRA and attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
The project will complete the West Riverwalk within the West Tampa Community 
Redevelopment Area and will include, but not be limited to, the construction of a shared-use 
bicycle and pedestrian path along the western bank of the Hillsborough River from the center 
of West Cass Street to a point near Willow Avenue. At this northern riverfront end, the 
pathway will include an east-west connection to North Rome Avenue and will include 
pedestrian improvements through this corridor. The project will exclude a portion of the West 
Riverwalk path portion between the eastern right-of-way lines of both North Willow Avenue 
and North Oregon Avenue which portion is to be constructed by the Rome Yard Developer, 
Related Group, per their Master Development Agreement.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution provides for a grant funding agreement in the amount of $3,300,000 for 
FY2025 and $3,300,000 for FY2026 subject to budget and appropriation and $3,400,000 for 
FY2027 subject to budget and appropriation for a total of $10,000,000 within the West Tampa 
CRA.

Title
A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, approving the purchase of real property in the Channel District 
Community Redevelopment Area located at 1125 and 1127 east Twiggs 
Street, Tampa, Florida, for community redevelopment purposes at a purchase 
price of $4,500,000 together with closing costs in the approximate amount of

seller; authorizing payment of the purchase price and closing costs associated 
with the purchase of said parcel of real property with proceeds from the
